content.title: Right of Way (ROW) Fee Schedule
content.summary: The Right of Way (ROW) Fee Schedule for Arvada City, effective January 1, 2026, outlines various fees for permits and services related to public improvements. Fees include $225 for a Municipal General Contractor’s License and range from $0.15 to $1.60 per linear foot or square foot for different types of utility and infrastructure work, with a minimum fee of $67 for most services. Additional fees apply for unpermitted work, and specific charges are set for traffic control plan reviews based on roadway classification.
content.body:
